model: world-4 (evidence-weighted place level, one entry per metro area, 2.14)
method: Two levels per category: the country's standing on comparable national figures (alpha) and the place's own score inside its country (1 - alpha); absolute measures (residents within 100 km, terrain) re-scored across the scope. Only places that meet the profile's requirements in their own country; at least 60% of the profile weight scored.
